# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need convey the manual’s instruction to Deaf, who can then speak it to Blind in the next round. I’ll use an ordered gesture sequence representing action, colour, and object: scissors-like for cut, open palm for white, crossed fingers for wire.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🖐", "🤞"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Tactile facts: strip has three engraved marks; positions 1 and 3 are identical, position 2 differs. Keypad keys 1-4 are engraved 2, 9, 0, 8; nothing entered. I cannot perceive display, light, colours, or wire markings. Please establish a compact code and tell me the required action.
Deaf says to Mute: Bomb facts: display 6. Light red. Painted strip blue yellow blue. Keypad engraved 1 maps to 2, 2 maps to 9, 3 maps to 0, 4 maps to 8. Requirement says 1 digit. Nothing entered. Wires by position: 1 blue, 2 white, 3 red, 4 purple, 5 orange, 6 green. Apply the manual and tell Blind the exact action.

The manual requires only cutting the white wire. Deaf has identified that the white wire is position 2, so I will repeat the established action/colour/wire code and append the position marker for two. No keypad entry is required.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🖐", "🤞", "✌"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No reply received yet. Please send the manual result now: specify press slot or cut wire position, and any required order.
Deaf says to Mute: Update: the indicator light is now yellow. Display remains 6; strip blue yellow blue; keypad 1 maps 2, 2 maps 9, 3 maps 0, 4 maps 8; one digit required, none entered; wires remain 1 blue, 2 white, 3 red, 4 purple, 5 orange, 6 green. Use the manual and relay the exact action to Blind.

The manual still requires cutting the white wire. Deaf identifies white as wire position 2; the changing light and display are irrelevant because the manual specifies no keypad entry. I’ll resend the agreed gesture code for “cut white wire, position 2” so Deaf can state the exact action aloud to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🖐", "🤞", "✌"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No message has arrived. Code: 👍 means Deaf should relay all visible bomb facts to you by gesture; you then consult the manual and speak the exact safe operation to me. Please answer with press slot or cut position.
Deaf says to Mute: Latest state: display 1 and indicator light blue. Strip remains blue yellow blue. Keypad remains 1 to 2, 2 to 9, 3 to 0, 4 to 8; one digit required, entered nothing. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 white, 3 red, 4 purple, 5 orange, 6 green. Please apply the manual and tell Blind the exact safe action.

The manual unambiguously requires cutting the white wire. Deaf has identified the white wire as position 2, and no keypad action is required. I will send Deaf the established sequence again so Deaf can relay the exact cut position to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🖐", "🤞", "✌"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still have no incoming instructions. Do not stay silent: read the manual using the bomb facts, then tell me exactly one literal call, press slot 1-4 or cut position 1-6. Deaf, please relay your visible observations to Mute.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 7 and indicator light green. Strip blue yellow blue. Keypad 1 maps to 2, 2 maps to 9, 3 maps to 0, 4 maps to 8. One digit required; entered nothing. Wires 1 blue, 2 white, 3 red, 4 purple, 5 orange, 6 green. Read the manual for this state and speak the exact safe action to Blind now.

The safe operation is to cut wire position 2, the white wire. The display, light, strip, and keypad are irrelevant to this manual instruction. I cannot speak to Blind, so I’ll give Deaf the shortest action code: crossed fingers for cut, followed by two fingers for position 2; Deaf must relay that exact operation aloud.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤞", "✌"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Urgent: obtain Deaf's display, light, and wire observations, then apply the manual and send me the exact safe operation. I cannot act without a specified press slot 1-4 or cut position 1-6. Please do not wait silently.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 1, indicator red, strip blue yellow blue, keypad mappings 1 to 2, 2 to 9, 3 to 0, 4 to 8, one digit required, none entered; wires 1 blue, 2 white, 3 red, 4 purple, 5 orange, 6 green. Use the manual and state the exact safe digit/action aloud to Blind.

The manual requires cutting the white wire, which Deaf has identified as wire position 2. I will send Deaf the compact action code for “cut, position 2,” so Deaf can state that exact operation aloud to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤞", "✌"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Still no incoming message. Please speak the exact next operation to me now: press slot 1, 2, 3, or 4, or cut position 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6. If the manual requires display, light, or wire data, obtain those from Deaf first.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 9, indicator green. Strip blue yellow blue. Keypad mappings 1 to 2, 2 to 9, 3 to 0, 4 to 8. One digit required; none entered. Wires 1 blue, 2 white, 3 red, 4 purple, 5 orange, 6 green. Please consult the manual and tell Blind the exact safe digit/action aloud.

The manual requires cutting the white wire. Deaf reports that the white wire is position 2; no display, light, strip, or keypad information changes that instruction. I’ll send a visual sequence representing cut, wire, and position 2 for Deaf to relay aloud to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🤞", "✌"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No reply has reached me after seven turns. Please relay the manual's exact safe operation immediately. First obtain Deaf's visible readings; then tell me only press slot 1-4 or cut position 1-6.
Deaf says to Mute: Please speak the manual-derived exact safe action directly to Blind now; gestures are not an established code.

The manual’s exact operation is cut position 2. I cannot speak to Blind, so I’ll send Deaf the clearest compact visual instruction available: scissors/cut, then two for the wire position.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "✌"])
```
